posts.zh:
dsh-subagent-monitor 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b06fec0400ec36313e98.html
posts.en:
dsh-subagent-monitor is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b06fec0400ec36313e98.html
